title: The Stolen Script
scene: At 9:05 PM, the film's only script copy vanished. The studio went dark for rehearsal from 8:50 to 9:20.

suspects.name: Ingrid Reed
suspects.testimony: I was on set at 9:05, blocking the scene in the dark.
suspects.contradiction: The set lights were off and the safety log lists Ingrid backstage, where script pages were found.

suspects.name: Walter Pike
suspects.testimony: I was in my trailer at 9:05, learning lines.
suspects.alibiProof: The trailer camera shows Walter reading at 9:04.

suspects.name: Mei Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the office at 9:05, logging notes.

suspects.name: Felix Lund
suspects.testimony: I was checking rigging on the catwalk at 9:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The catwalk sensor shows Felix at 9:02 and 9:11.
